## Description

For years, Uber sold rides for less than they cost. Riders paid about 41 percent of each trip, by one estimate. So who paid the rest? We follow the dollar from the first night in Paris to the first full year of operating profit, in 2023: investors, drivers, taxi owners, and finally you.

0:00 Cold open
0:45 The setup
2:30 The decision
5:00 Follow the dollar
9:00 What it cost
12:00 The lesson

Nothing is free. Every bargain, perk and "free" app is paid for by someone. Twice a week, we follow the dollar to find out whose dime it is.
